rows.name: Weak spot deals more than body
rows.setup: equip glock; spawn watcher A and B 10 m ahead, AI disabled, full health and armor
steps: aim_at(A, body); fire()
aim_at(B, eye); fire()
strider and grazer: weak_spots() not empty
pass_criteria: weak damage > body damage
weak damage == glock.damage * glock.headshot_mult * falloff (= 120 at 0 m, ~105.6 at 10 m)
body damage == glock.damage * glock.armor_ratio * combat.armor_ratio_scale * falloff (= 14.1 at 0 m, ~12.4 at 10 m) while armor > 0
falloff = range_modifier ^ (distance_u / combat.range_step_u), distance from fire().point/.distance (else camera to machine +-1.5 m)
each machine loses exactly the reported damage
every machine type reports >= 1 weak spot, including its sheet weak_spot_parts

rows.name: Route measurement Low and High: game and converter RAM, VRAM, GPU and CPU time, fps
rows.setup: t25 (main process) starts one child per preset, low then high (--autotest t25run --out <out>/t25/<preset> --user-dir <out>/t25/user_<preset> --gfx-preset <preset> --fps-limit 0, window perf.resolution), so the presets share no memory; the game args of the parent are forwarded (warm cache); child: vsync off and invulnerable (setup); all behaviour through lib/inputsim.gd (Input.parse_input_event); Game API and GraphicsSettings only for setup and reading state
steps: child: after world_ready + 3x3 + perf.settle_s walk perf.route_cells by input as t15 (held W, mouse steering, jump when blocked, leg teleport fallback counted)
every frame: wall-clock frame time, GPU and CPU time (perf.gpu_time_rule); every perf.mem_sample_s: game and converter RAM (perf.ram_rule) and VRAM
after the route: stand still until the converter is idle (perf.converter_idle_settle_s, at most perf.converter_idle_wait_max_s), sample its RAM
child writes <out>/t25/<preset>/frametimes.csv (t_s, frame_ms, phase, cell, event, vram_mb, gpu_ms, cpu_ms) and mem.csv
pass_criteria: low: average GPU time <= perf.low_gpu_ms_max ms/frame
low: peak game RAM <= perf.low_game_ram_max_mb, peak VRAM <= perf.low_vram_max_mb
high: fps avg >= perf.target_fps_avg, 1 % low >= perf.target_fps_1pct_low, no frame > perf.max_load_frame_ms while a cell loads
high: peak game RAM <= perf.high_game_ram_max_mb
both: converter RAM when idle <= perf.converter_idle_max_mb
both: route visited >= 10 distinct cells; details per preset: GPU and CPU ms (avg, p99), fps avg and 1 % low, worst frames, RAM and VRAM peak and end, converter RAM peak and idle
